My heart goes out to all affected by the shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego. Places of worship should be sanctuaries of peace, not violence.

I’m grateful for the first responders and am praying for the families of the victims.

Johnathan Burch, a native of Heath Springs, South Carolina, has been named a 2026 Truman Scholar, one of 55 outstanding students selected nationwide. Jonathan represents academic excellence, exemplary leadership, and a commitment to public service. Congratulations, on this incredible accomplishment! #SCSweetTea tri-statedefender.com/rhodes…

Under @POTUS’ leadership, America and the world are safer. God bless the brave warfighters who carried out this successful mission.


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

“Tonight, at my direction, brave American forces and the Armed Forces of Nigeria flawlessly executed a meticulously planned and very complex mission to eliminate the most active terrorist in the world from the battlefield. Abu-Bilal al-Minuki, second in command of ISIS…” - President Trump





— https://nitter.net/WhiteHouse/status/2
Over 50,000 students benefit from the innovative education at charter schools across the Palmetto State! #NationalCharterSchoolsWeek

This week, the Senate Banking Committee proved Washington can still work together.

Passing the bipartisan Clarity Act was historic and personal to me. My mother raised my brother and me with faith, grit, and determination, teaching us that the American Dream should be within reach for every family.

Proud of @BankingGOP for taking a step forward to make America the crypto capital of the world!

The Working Families Tax Cuts support rural hospitals across South Carolina and all 50 states with a $50 billion investment to strengthen and modernize care. Every community deserves access to high-quality healthcare, regardless of ZIP code. #NationalHospitalWeek

HBCUs have long been engines of opportunity, but for far too long, too many have been asked to do more with less. My bill, the IGNITE for HBCU Excellence Act, will help modernize campuses, expand research and workforce training opportunities, and make sure students are prepared to succeed in a 21st-century economy. scott.senate.gov/media-cente…

The future of finance should be built in America, under American laws, and with American values.

The Clarity Act takes the side of everyday Americans, protects investors, strengthens national security, and keeps America leading the world.

Video

If someone in South Carolina invests in digital assets, they deserve real, enforceable legal protections.

The Clarity Act puts everyday Americans first with clear disclosures, safeguards against fraud, and rules that keep markets open and fair.

Video

Headed to @BankingGOP to advance the CLARITY Act - a major step forward in ensuring America is the global leader in financial innovation and opportunity. 

Today, we take one step closer to making America the crypto capital of the world!

Video
Every student is uniquely worthy of high-quality education, and charter schools give parents the freedom to choose what works best for their families. #NationalCharterSchoolsWeek

SNAP benefits are a lifeline for those in need, not a piggy bank for criminals. Security lapses in Minnesota are enabling fraud while hungry families suffer. I cosponsored the Enhanced Cybersecurity for SNAP Act to strengthen protections against fraud, modernize the SNAP payment system, and preserve access for families who need it most. foxnews.com/politics/million…

Hear how families and students across South Carolina are thriving and unlocking their full potential from the freedom to choose their best educational path for success! #NationalCharterSchoolsWeek

Video

Kevin Warsh is battle-tested, serious, and ready to lead the Federal Reserve. President Trump made an excellent choice.

I look forward to working with Chair Warsh to keep the Fed independent, depoliticized, and focused on affordability and opportunity for American families.


U.S. Senate Banking Committee GOP (@BankingGOP)

NEW: The Senate has confirmed Kevin Warsh to lead the Federal Reserve.

Read Chairman @SenatorTimScott’s statement below:

During National Police Week, we honor the brave men and women in blue who show up every day to protect our communities. Because of their courage and sacrifices, Americans across our nation are safer.
During National Charter Schools Week, we celebrate the more than 8,000 charter schools that provide high-quality and flexible education, helping students across the nation reach their potential!
